### parseChord()

```ts
function parseChord(
  binding,
  mac,
): Readonly<{
  key: string;
  alt: boolean;
  ctrl: boolean;
  meta: boolean;
  shift: boolean;
}> | null;
```

Parse one single-chord binding. Sequences (including `<leader> x`) and unknown
modifiers return `null`; they are never matched as one chord.

### installShellKeys()

```ts
function installShellKeys(root, host, mac): () => void;
```

Dispatch the active view's single-chord bindings from the shell document. Text
entry is a mode: while an input is focused only Ctrl/Cmd chords fire, so
Alt-arrows keep their word-navigation meaning.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type                            |
| --------- | ------------------------------- |
| `root`    | `HTMLElement`                   |
| `host`    | [`ShellKeyHost`](#shellkeyhost) |
| `mac`     | `boolean`                       |

#### Returns

() => `void`
